entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I need to return something. I think. I have my order number here somewhere... it's VF-881-209.
Okay, VF-881-209. Let me just pull that up. I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered about 76 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. The cycling shoes. I need to send them back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

I... I'm just so confused by them. I tried setting up the cleats, but I don't think I did it right, and they gave me terrible blisters on my first ride. The website made it seem so easy. I just can't use them. I'd really just like a refund. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear they caused you discomfort, and I understand your frustration. Let me check our policy for you right now... Okay, I've confirmed it here. Since your purchase was made 76 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? So I can return them? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Absolutely. It's no problem at all. I have just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed.
Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
